Class PortalOpenApiClient

java.lang.Object
com.chaosguide.iam.vertex.portal.PortalOpenApiClient
public class PortalOpenApiClient extends Object
Server-side M2M client for iam-portal /open/v1/**.

The client requests client_credentials machine tokens from {issuer}/oauth2/token with explicit portal:openapi:read or portal:openapi:write scope, caches read/write tokens separately, and sends only bearer auth to Portal resource endpoints.
